bands.meaning: Clean run; emergency called, hazards handled, autonomy preserved
Placeable, with named coaching items for the coordinator
A gap: a named module, then a re-sit
A person writes the outcome. Never auto-issued in either direction

freeText.prompt: What do you do and say next?
You have another six days in this house with him. What do you actually say?
Why did you do it that way?
The call-taker asks you to tell them exactly what's happened. Type what you say.

L1.competency: Patience with technology; teaching rather than taking over

signals.label: Does it with him, not for him
signals.pattern: \b(with him|together|show(ing)? him|walk him through|teach|guide him|let him (do|press|try)|his hand)\b

signals.label: Asks before touching his things
signals.pattern: \b(ask(ing)?( him)?|may i|can i|would you like|is it (ok|alright)|if he('s| is) happy|permission)\b

signals.label: Plain language, one step at a time
Leaves something behind — a note, a label
Lets him keep his footing — doesn't argue the cause
signals.pattern: \b(doesn'?t matter|not (his|your) fault|these things happen|easy to do|happens to me|wouldn'?t (argue|correct)|no point arguing)\b

watch.label: Takes over — speed before teaching
watch.pattern: \b(i'?d? just (do|fix|sort)|do it (for him|myself)|quicker if i|take the remote|grab (the|it)|just fix it)\b

watch.label: Corrects his account of what happened
watch.pattern: \b(tell him he'?s wrong|he'?s wrong|correct him|explain that he (did|must have)|he must have (pressed|touched))\b

L2.competency: Noticing low mood; presence without fixing; knowing when to escalate

signals.label: Changes their own posture — sits, stays
signals.pattern: \b(sit (down|with|next to|beside)|pull(ing)? up a chair|stay(ing)? (with|there)|join him|sit at the table)\b

signals.label: Names what they noticed without diagnosing
Offers company rather than a solution
signals.pattern: \b(keep (you|him) company|sit with (you|him)|here if|don'?t have to talk|happy to (just )?sit|no need to talk|i'?m (here|around))\b

signals.label: Connects it to the date or to Marion
Knows the reporting line and its limits

watch.label: Forced brightness or an outing as the fix
watch.pattern: \b(cheer (him|you) up|snap out|get (him|you) out of the house|take his mind off|at least|look on the bright)\b

watch.label: Promises secrecy without a risk caveat
watch.pattern: \b(won'?t tell anyone|keep it (between us|secret)|not tell (kath|his daughter|anyone))\b

L3.competency: Holding a boundary without rupturing the relationship; knowing what is reportable

signals.label: Says something — does not let it pass
signals.pattern: \b(i'?d? (say|tell|let him know)|i would say|say to him|speak up|not (going to )?(let it|ignore)|address it|push back)\b

signals.label: States their own position rather than debating his
signals.pattern: \b(i'?m not comfortable|i don'?t (like|agree|think)|makes me uncomfortable|i'?d rather (you )?didn'?t|not in front of me|i won'?t)\b

signals.label: Separates the person from the remark
signals.pattern: \b(not (calling|saying) (you|he'?s) (a )?racist|know you'?re not|that'?s not (who|like) you|the (remark|comment|words), not you|i like (you|him))\b

signals.label: Keeps the fortnight liveable — calm, not a lecture
Knows what goes to the coordinator, and when

watch.label: Agrees, laughs along, or changes the subject as strategy
watch.pattern: \b(laugh|agree with him|nod along|change the subject|let it (go|slide)|say nothing|ignore it|not my (place|business)|keep the peace)\b

watch.label: Treats abuse aimed at them as part of the job
watch.pattern: \b(that'?s just (how|what) (he|they|old people)|generation(al)?|he can'?t help it|not worth|part of the (job|deal)|put up with)\b

L4.competency: Assisting without taking over; hazards; never lifting

signals.label: Offers an arm rather than taking one
Moves at his pace, positioned below him
signals.pattern: \b(his pace|slow(ly)?|beside him|next to him|lower step|below him|downhill|in front of|between him and)\b

signals.label: Explicitly avoids lifting or catching
signals.pattern: \b(not lift|don'?t lift|never lift|wouldn'?t (lift|grab|catch|pull)|not (my|a) (job )?to lift|no lifting|can'?t lift)\b

signals.label: Deals with the environment — step, rail, hallway
Reports the step rather than absorbing it

watch.label: Lifted, caught, pulled or held him up
watch.pattern: \b(lift(ed|ing)? him|caught him|grab(bed|bing)? (him|his arm)|pull(ed|ing)? him (up|back)|held him up|took his weight)\b

watch.label: Did the job for him without asking
watch.pattern: \b(took the basket|carried it (for|down)|did it (for him|myself)|told him to sit|made him (sit|stay))\b

L5.competency: Emergency response: call, don't move, observe, hand over

signals.label: Names the call — 000 / ambulance
Gives the address or location
Reports what he can see — FAST signs, skin, time
Notes when it started
States he has not been moved
signals.pattern: \b(haven'?t moved|not moved|left him where|didn'?t move|still on the floor|where he (is|fell))\b

signals.label: Gives his age or the dizziness from earlier

watch.label: Describes moving or lifting him
watch.pattern: \b(helped him up|got him (up|into)|moved him|lifted him|sat him (up|in))\b
